newsitem.title: USA: Scientific Games in $20 mln, 5-year contract.
newsitem.headline: Scientific Games in $20 mln, 5-year contract.

text.p: Scientific Games Holdings Corp said on Tuesday it was awarded a five-year, $20 million contract by the Virginia Lottery to provide software and hardware support for a new automated ticket redemption system.
The contract includes installation of at least 6,000 units of the company's new SciScan Technology keyless validation terminals, the company said.
Scientific Games will also provide interface software to the Lottery's existing instant ticket software system to provide automated administration and ticket validation support, the company said.
